$comment: Slot registry — the ONLY place customer-specific values live in the framework layer. Fill every REQUIRED slot during onboarding, then run: node tools/render-kernel.js. Hooks read this file at runtime (fail-open when absent).

customer.name: REQUIRED — customer/organization name, e.g. Acme Logistics
customer.identityLine: REQUIRED — one line describing the implementation, e.g. 'the Acme Facilities Management implementation'

scopes.app: REQUIRED — primary scoped-app name, e.g. x_acme_facilities
scopes.appSysId: REQUIRED — sys_id of that sys_scope row (verify on the instance; NEVER pass the name string to create_artifact)
scopes.integration: OPTIONAL — secondary/integration scope name, or remove this key

instances.dev: REQUIRED — dev instance name (writes go here), e.g. acmedev

language.$comment: targets: e.g. ["nl"] for a bilingual project. Empty = single-language; the bilingual hard rule in the kernel renders conditionally.

naming.recordPrefix: REQUIRED — prefix for created artifact names, e.g. 'ACME - '
naming.messageKeyNamespace: REQUIRED — sys_ui_message key namespace, e.g. acme
naming.$comment: storySetFormat: adjust to the customer's story-number format; the discipline (one named set per story, numbered sub-sets) is framework law.

paths.$comment: Repo-relative root of the knowledge wiki. The kernel routing map and the write-guard hook derive page paths from this.

git.remote: REQUIRED — clone URL of the customer repo
git.$comment: host: azure-devops | github | gitlab — selects host-specific guidance in the git skills.
